title: Can Estee Lauder's New Skin Science Strategy Fuel Long-Term Growth?
author: Na
description: Estee Lauder introduced Mastering Skin Longevity, a scientific innovation platform built on over 20 years of research to accelerate product development in anti-aging and skin health. The platform unites five brands (Estee Lauder, La Mer, Clinique, Lab Series, and The Ordinary) and focuses on Master Regulators of Skin Longevity. The company expects fiscal 2027 organic sales growth of 4-5.5% with adjusted operating margins of 12.9-13.7%, supported by recent 4% organic skin care sales growth and 9% growth in Mainland China.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company launched a significant innovation platform backed by 20+ years of research, demonstrated recent organic sales growth of 4% in skin care and 9% in key market (Mainland China), received Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), and outperformed sector benchmarks with 13.4% gains in past month. Forward guidance of 4-5.5% organic growth shows confidence, though valuation premium (P/E 31.01 vs. industry 26.71) and unproven commercial benefits present some caution.

Company holds Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with consensus estimates for 24% sales growth and 18.9% earnings growth, plus exceptional trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of 80.5%, indicating strong operational execution and market momentum.

Company carries Zacks Rank #2 with modest consensus estimates for 11.7% sales growth and 6.8% EPS growth, and a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of only 4.8%, suggesting stable but unexceptional performance.

Company holds Zacks Rank #2 with consensus estimate for 17.1% earnings growth and a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of 13.8%, indicating solid but not exceptional performance relative to other highlighted stocks.

title: COTY or EL: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
author: Na
description: In a comparison of cosmetics stocks, Coty (COTY) emerges as the superior value investment over Estee Lauder (EL). Coty holds a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) versus EL's #3 (Hold), indicating stronger earnings estimate revisions. Coty also demonstrates more attractive valuation metrics with a forward P/E of 12.47 compared to EL's 31.35, a PEG ratio of 0.76 versus 1.44, and a P/B ratio of 1.05 versus 9.65, earning a Value grade of B versus EL's D.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Coty demonstrates stronger fundamentals with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), lower forward P/E ratio (12.47), lower PEG ratio (0.76), and lower P/B ratio (1.05), combined with a Value grade of B, indicating it is undervalued and has positive earnings estimate revision trends.

Estee Lauder shows weaker metrics with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), significantly higher forward P/E ratio (31.35), higher PEG ratio (1.44), and much higher P/B ratio (9.65), combined with a Value grade of D, suggesting it is overvalued relative to Coty.

title: EL's Fiscal 2030 Roadmap Targets Stronger Growth & Higher Margins
author: Na
description: Estée Lauder Companies (EL) announced ambitious growth targets at its Capital Markets Experience event, aiming for mid-single-digit organic net sales growth and double-digit adjusted diluted EPS growth through fiscal 2030, with an adjusted operating margin target of 16.5-18.5%. The company plans to achieve these goals through innovation, the One ELC operating model, cost efficiencies, and improved working capital management. EL shares have gained 20% over the past month and currently carry a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company announced strong long-term growth targets (mid-single-digit organic sales and double-digit EPS growth through 2030), demonstrated recent stock performance (+20% over past month), received Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, and outlined concrete operational improvements through its One ELC model and Profit Recovery initiatives. Consensus estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 have been revised upward.

Carries Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), consensus estimates suggest fiscal-year earnings growth of 12.9% and sales growth of 10.7%, and delivered a trailing four-quarter average earnings surprise of 7.6%.

While the company carries Zacks Rank #2, consensus estimates indicate current fiscal-year earnings decline of 14.6% and sales decline of 3.5%. However, it delivered a strong trailing four-quarter average earnings surprise of 43%, suggesting potential upside despite near-term headwinds.
Carries Zacks Rank #2, consensus estimates suggest fiscal-year earnings growth of 6.8% and sales growth of 13.3%, indicating solid operational performance and growth trajectory.

title: KHC Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Emerging Markets Sales Rise
author: Na
description: Kraft Heinz reported Q3 2026 earnings of 53 cents per share and sales of $6.12 billion, beating consensus estimates despite declining year-over-year. North America sales fell 3.4% due to softer U.S. retail demand, while Emerging Markets surged 13.8%. The company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $2.07-$2.13 per share, though it maintains expectations for operating income to decline 16-18% for the full year.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite beating Q3 estimates, KHC faces significant headwinds including 2% net sales decline, 13.1% year-over-year earnings decline, 40 basis point gross margin contraction, and 230 basis point operating margin contraction. North America sales fell 3.4% with weakness in U.S. retail. The company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating and stock has underperformed the industry.

Lamb Weston carries a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) with consensus estimates implying 7.6% EPS growth and a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise average of 22.1%, indicating consistent outperformance.
Smucker holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with consensus estimates implying 17.1% EPS growth and a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise average of 13.8%, demonstrating solid performance.
Estee Lauder carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with consensus estimates indicating 5.3% sales growth and 35.1% EPS growth, plus a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise average of nearly 26%.

title: Estee Lauder (EL) Is Up 0.52% in One Week: What You Should Know
